policies.title: Mainland Chinese ordinary passports: Kyrgyzstan electronic visa
policies.summary: Chinese ordinary-passport holders require a Kyrgyz visa and may apply through Kyrgyzstan's electronic-visa route before travel.
conditions: The bilateral visa waiver is confined to Chinese diplomatic and official passports, not ordinary passports.
The separate seven-day entry for qualifying US, UK or Schengen visa holders is conditional and excluded.

application.label: Kyrgyzstan electronic visa service
application.processingTime: The official Chinese MFA guidance says an expedited service may reduce review to two days; it does not promise a standard decision time.
steps: Submit the online visa application and electronic materials.
Receive the visa decision before travel.

policies.title: Mainland Chinese ordinary passports: Iraq electronic visa
policies.summary: Since 1 March 2025, Iraq requires Chinese citizens to obtain an electronic visa through the designated site before entry.
conditions: This is Iraq's federal route for an ordinary Chinese visitor.
The Kurdistan-region airport arrival route is territory-specific and is excluded.

application.label: Iraq electronic visa service
steps: Apply through Iraq's designated electronic-visa site before travel.
Receive the electronic visa before border entry.

policies.title: Mainland Chinese ordinary passports: Jordan visa on arrival
policies.summary: Chinese citizens may obtain a Jordanian visa at entry ports; that arrival-issued route controls over the parallel eVisa option.
conditions: Chinese travellers may alternatively use Jordan's Interior Ministry eVisa service.
The Chinese MFA advises arranging a visa before departure to reduce refusal risk; this operational advice does not remove the stated arrival-visa route.

policies.title: Mainland Chinese ordinary passports: Tunisia tourist visa-free entry
policies.summary: Chinese tourists may enter Tunisia without a visa.
conditions: Tourists must present a paid hotel voucher and return ticket matching the stay.
Business, study, work, family-visit and other non-tourist purposes require advance visas.

policies.title: Mainland Chinese ordinary passports: Peru advance visa
policies.summary: A mainland Chinese private ordinary passport requires a Peruvian visa for tourism or other short visits.
conditions: The visa-free route for a qualifying US, Canadian, UK, Australian or Schengen visa or permanent residence document is conditional and excluded.
Diplomatic, official and Hong Kong SAR passport arrangements are excluded.

policies.title: Mainland Chinese ordinary passports: Panama advance visa
policies.summary: A Chinese citizen travelling privately to Panama must apply through the Panamanian Embassy's consular section before travel.
conditions: The mutual arrangement provides multiple-entry visas for ordinary passports; it is not visa-free entry.
The stated waiver for holders of specified third-country visas or residence cards is conditional and excluded.

policies.title: Mainland Chinese ordinary passports: Comoros visa on arrival
policies.summary: Chinese citizens may obtain a biometric visa at Moroni International Airport; ordinary-passport holders pay the stated visa fee.
conditions: The China-Comoros visa waiver is confined to diplomatic, official and public-affairs passports.
The ordinary-passport visa is valid for no more than 45 days under the stated guidance.

policies.title: Mainland Chinese ordinary passports: Marshall Islands advance visa
policies.summary: Chinese citizens must apply to the Marshall Islands Immigration Office for a visa before entry.
conditions: This is an advance-application rule; no arrival-issued route is established.
It does not classify work-visa procedures, diplomatic passports, or final admission.

policies.title: Mainland Chinese ordinary passports: North Macedonia advance visa
policies.summary: A mainland Chinese private ordinary passport requires a North Macedonian visa obtained before entry.
conditions: North Macedonia does not operate a visa-on-arrival route according to the current Chinese MFA guidance.
The listed third-country-document exemptions were time-limited through 31 December 2025 and are not used for this baseline; diplomatic, official and public-affairs passports are excluded.

conflicts.explanation: Current Chinese MFA guidance says Chinese citizens may obtain a biometric visa at Moroni airport and expressly charges ordinary-passport holders a EUR 30 visa fee; the bilateral waiver is limited to diplomatic, official and public-affairs passports.

unresolved.reason: No current Afghan or Chinese government source establishes an ordinary mainland Chinese-passport short-visitor route and actual issuance timing.
Current Burkina Faso official material does not map an ordinary mainland Chinese passport to an electronic, advance or arrival-issued visitor route. Portal availability is not eligibility proof.
No current Central African or Chinese government source establishes the ordinary mainland Chinese-passport visitor route and actual issuance timing.
Chad's current eVisa material does not provide independently authenticated ordinary mainland Chinese-passport eligibility and issuance timing. No portal complement is inferred.
No current Republic of the Congo or Chinese government source establishes an ordinary mainland Chinese-passport visitor route and actual issuance timing.
Côte d'Ivoire's online pre-enrolment material does not establish ordinary mainland Chinese-passport eligibility or prove electronic visa issuance rather than a preliminary process.
Current Djiboutian electronic-visa sources establish processing but not a mainland Chinese ordinary-passport eligibility or exemption schedule. No status is inferred from the portal.
Eswatini's current Government schedule contains conflicting China and People's Republic of China rows. No current reconciling authority establishes a normalized mainland Chinese-passport status.
No current Guinea-Bissau or Chinese government source establishes an ordinary mainland Chinese-passport visitor route and actual issuance timing.

Chinese MFA guidance identifies only conditional third-country-visa and official-passport visa-free routes for Honduras; it does not establish the ordinary mainland Chinese-passport baseline. No complement is inferred.

Current Kuwaiti Interior material does not produce a positive controlling ordinary mainland Chinese tourist-nationality result. GCC-resident, profession and third-country-document routes are excluded.
Liberia's official online and arrival procedures are conditional on residence and mission availability and publish no mainland Chinese nationality schedule.

Macao's Public Security Police treats a PRC passport only as a seven-day transit document with an onward ticket and destination-entry visa; normal Mainland travel uses separate exit permits. This is not a passport-only visitor baseline.
No current Malian or Chinese government source establishes an ordinary mainland Chinese-passport visitor route and actual issuance timing.
Niger's current default preserves unenumerated bilateral and community exemptions; no current ordinary mainland Chinese-passport schedule resolves this visitor route.

Current DPRK official material describes consular tourist-visa procedures but no ordinary mainland Chinese-passport visitor eligibility or issuance timing. Operational access restrictions are not normalized.
No current Palestinian ordinary-passport nationality matrix establishes a visa, eVisa, ETA, arrival-visa or visa-free route. Israeli crossing controls are route-specific and excluded.
Current Sierra Leone official material conflicts on electronic versus airport issuance timing. No source reconciles the ordinary mainland Chinese-passport route.

South Sudan's electronic service does not publish an ordinary mainland Chinese-passport eligibility schedule, and its current country table does not establish issuance timing. No portal inference is made.
Sudan's current Passport Directorate material identifies visitor categories and counter processing but not ordinary mainland Chinese-passport eligibility or prior approval.

Chinese MFA guidance says ordinary passport holders can submit an electronic visa application, but does not establish actual electronic issuance rather than an online advance-application step. The eVisa label is therefore held.

Taiwan treats Mainland Area people through purpose-, residence-, permit- and travel-document-conditioned entry-and-exit routes. An ordinary mainland PRC passport alone does not establish a visitor-visa baseline.

Current Chinese MFA guidance says an ordinary Chinese passport needs a Turkmen visa but does not establish actual issuance timing or exclude invitation/preapproval conditions. The generic visa wording is not normalized.
